intro: Fishing licences and copra are Kiribati's main earners.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Foreign fishing fleets pay to fish for tuna in its vast waters. Copra and seaweed are exported. A national fund saved from old phosphate mining supports the budget.

chapters.title: Phosphate
text: Banaba island was stripped by phosphate mining in the 1900s.

keyTerms.meaning: Sea area where a country controls fishing.
